a.lede: Prime minister says he told chief executive he was disappointed it had taken company ‘way too long’ to inform government of breach Anthony Albanese says an artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI hacked Medicare in June and the tech giant notified the government earlier this month using an email sent to a public-facing mailbox. Australia’s prime minister made the comments
a.title: Anthony Albanese says OpenAI agent hacked Medicare and he expressed ‘extreme concern’ to Sam Altman

b.lede: Albanese said he expressed "concern" to OpenAI founder Sam Altman, after authorities were informed three months after the breach in June.
b.title: OpenAI agent 'infiltrated' Australian government website, PM says
